facts.did: 带着毫不动摇的决心回到 Memory 遵守对 Murtis 的承诺；若 Spiralstair 不放人，就找遍校园每个实验室（除造武器外什么都愿意做）
facts.anchor: returned to the Memory with an unwavering determination

facts.did: 读完 Gardenpath 的研究与 Plumline 的笔记后，让其继续田野工作，理由是进展相当显著
facts.anchor: I suppose you should get on with your fieldwork

facts.did: 这次近乎反高潮的对话标志其一生中最好时代的开始
facts.anchor: marked the beginning of the best eon in Gardenpath’s life

facts.did: Turret 成为 Arch 所在实验室的教授（做与冰粒有关的东西）；Nuraghe 加入反战社群成为领袖，在 Wainscot 通过第四次后不久通过第三次
facts.anchor: passed the Third shortly after Wainscot passed the Fourth

facts.did: 在同伴中最早通过第四次；几程后宣布获准参加第五次，当时是 Wandertime，大家正吃新收的蜜莓
facts.anchor: had been granted an audience for the Fifth

facts.did: 已花近四十五个征程不停地写论文，却不断找借口延长——因为一旦通过第四次，就再无定期去 Tentacle 的理由
facts.anchor: they kept finding excuses to extend it

facts.did: 把 Column 与 Wainscot 的暧昧比作十二卷浪漫小说：慢热已烧了十一卷半，并问会不会有第十三卷
facts.anchor: This is like reading a twelve-book romance series

facts.did: Wainscot 带着最后一次群体召唤的余香回宿舍、无法停止伸长时，Gardenpath 在陷入无意识之际尝到 Wainscot 体内的 Column——终于；群体一起分享喜悦
facts.anchor: Gardenpath could taste Column in Wainscot’s body. Finally.

relations.relation: 暧昧终于显影（恋情）：群体一起分享喜悦，Gardenpath 尝到 Column 在 Wainscot 体内
relations.anchor: The cluster oozed together, everyone sharing their joy

relations.relation: 提携：Turret 成为 Arch 所在实验室的教授
relations.anchor: Turret became a professor in the lab where Arch worked

relations.relation: 同圈伙伴：Gardenpath 的圈子扩大到包含 Nuraghe 与 Turret
relations.anchor: which had grown to include Nuraghe and Turret

relations.relation: 伴侣/同侪：Oriel 与 Gardenpath 一起进行论文写作约会，田野行程也被安排在同一批征程
relations.anchor: Oriel joined them on dissertation writing dates

relations.relation: 保护性的导师：Oriel 称 Column 为 protective adviser，Column 希望其在十五个征程内完成以便下个时代合作
relations.anchor: Always the protective adviser, Column. Thank you. I’ll try.

numbers.fact: Oriel 自称还需要另外二十个征程才宣布打算参加第四次考试
numbers.anchor: I’m going to need another twenty journeys to declare

numbers.fact: Gardenpath 已花近四十五个征程不停地写论文，并不断找借口延长
numbers.anchor: They had spent nearly forty-five journeys working nonstop

numbers.fact: Oriel 形容这段慢热恋已持续十一卷半（共十二卷的浪漫系列）
numbers.anchor: where the slow burn has lasted for eleven and a half books

numbers.fact: Wainscot 终于明白其他人几乎两个时代前就已经知道的事
numbers.anchor: what everyone else had known for almost two eons
